summary: This note describes Fort Hill, also called the John C. Calhoun Mansion and Library, a National Historic Landmark located on the Clemson University campus in Clemson, South Carolina. The house was the home of John C. Calhoun, a leading national politician, from 1825 to 1850. It is now maintained as a museum and library in his memory.
one_line: Fort Hill is a National Historic Landmark on Clemson University's campus, once home of politician John C. Calhoun and now a museum and library.
